bodyText.heading: Location
bodyText.text: The category E halls of residence are located in the old town centre and in Bergheim, 0.5-1.7 km from the school. The walk to the school is only 8-20 minutes. You can reach the school by public transport in approx. 8 minutes.

bodyText.heading: Equipment
bodyText.text: In addition to a bed, wardrobe, desk and chair, each room has its own kitchenette and bathroom including shower, WC and washbasin.These are sample pictures of our halls of residence.

bodyText.text: The Category B dormitory is located 5 km from the school. It takes approximately 15–25 minutes to reach the school by public transport.

bodyText.heading: Equipment
bodyText.text: The communal kitchen is a central meeting point for our international students. It's a place where they can cook together and practise their German language skills. The toilet is located on the same floor. Each room is equipped with a bed, a wardrobe, a desk, a chair, and Wi-Fi. Additionally, it has a refrigerator, a shower, and a sink.

bodyText.heading: General information on halls of residence in Heidelberg
bodyText.text: We offer many different accommodation options: the school's own halls of residence andFlats, hotels or host families. Please note that location, size and furnishings may vary.of the halls of residence vary depending on the category. JourneyYou will receive an e-mail from us one to two weeks before your arrival with all the details toCheck in, to your accommodation and to hand over the keys. Check-in takes place on Sundays between10:00 and 22:00. Exceptions to this rule must be agreed with the accommodation team.be agreed.DeparturePlease make an appointment to move out with the accommodation department (at the latest onThursday before your last day). Check-out is on Saturdays before 12:00 noon. The key handoverwill be made directly with our employee after checking your room. If your arrival is delayed due to force majeure, you must expect that we may no longer be able to guarantee your booked room category or your hall of residence. In this case, we reserve the right to accommodate you in another hall of residence and/or another category of hall of residence.In this case, the price difference for a lower dormitory category or the dormitory guarantee amount will be refunded in full,

bodyText.heading: Exam preparation
bodyText.text: Prepare specifically for important language examinations such as TOEFL, IELTS, TestDaF or telc. Our specialised courses will give you the knowledge and confidence you need to succeed in the exam.

bodyText.heading: Language tests
bodyText.text: We offer certified language examinations. Whether TestDaF, onSET or TOEFL. Find out more about dates for 2025 here.

bodyText.heading: German courses
bodyText.text: Learn German flexibly and effectively - with our professional German courses.

bodyText.heading: English courses
bodyText.text: Improve your English skills - on site in Heidelberg or conveniently online. Our courses are practice-orientated and suitable for all levels so that you can achieve your language goals quickly.
